sections.text: A storm drives your fishing boat onto the rocks near an old lighthouse. Its lamp still burns, though the keeper vanished years ago.

options.description: Climb the spiral stairs toward the light
Search the keeper's cottage at the base

sections.text: Halfway up, a rotted step gives way beneath you.

options.description: Grab the railing and pull yourself up

consequence.text: You land awkwardly, wrenching your knee.

sections.text: The cottage is dusty but undisturbed. A logbook lies open on the desk, its last entry unfinished.

options.description: Head up to the lamp room instead

sections.text: You reach the lamp room, breathless. The great lens turns slowly, powered by nothing you can see.

options.description: Look for the mechanism below it

sections.text: Nursing your knee, you reach the lamp room landing anyway.

options.description: Look for the mechanism below it

sections.text: The log describes a light that 'shows sailors the way they most need, not the way they asked for.' You feel drawn upward.
The moment your fingers brush the glass, you see your own boat, safely home, years from now.
Beneath the lens, gears turn on their own. You realize the lighthouse was never waiting for its keeper to return — it was waiting for someone to finally let it rest.
